purpose: Teach: 憶測/押しつける/歩む/破る/取り戻し/引っ張り/とらわれ/奪う

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、世間の、絶対、憶測、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に対応中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're treating this matter with the utmost seriousness and care. Public speculation is something we're navigating cautiously every step of the way.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Even cadence throughout. Slight pause before 'public speculation'—the weight of responsibility. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、容疑者が、絶対、責任、絶対、押しつける、絶対、行為、絶対、警察、絶対、看破されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the police saw through what the suspect was trying to pin on others. That takes real work.
lines.style: Genuine observation, not quite a question. Quiet admiration underneath. Thoughtful pace. Leans into the realization as he speaks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、犯罪者と共に、絶対、歩む、絶対、道、絶対、ありません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We don't walk the same path as criminals. That line is absolute.
lines.style: Firm, clear statement. No ambiguity. Brief and final. The weight of institutional principle, delivered without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、容疑者、絶対、約束、絶対、破る、絶対、警察、絶対、対応中ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the suspect broke a promise, and the police are handling it. That's what matters now.
lines.style: Quiet understanding. Not excusing anything. Steady tone that acknowledges hard facts. Slight fade at the end—acceptance of difficult reality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、被害品、絶対、取り戻し、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've recovered the stolen items. That much is done.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact. Minimal but not cold. A small nod of completion. Professional satisfaction that the practical work is finished.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、組織の、絶対、引っ張り、絶対、出し、絶対、進めております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: We're working through the organizational side of this now. It's ongoing.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Forward momentum. No drama—just the work that comes after. Quiet competence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者、本気で、絶対、過去に、絶対、とらわれ、絶対、ない、絶対、心、絶対、警察、絶対、サポートしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The victim doesn't have to hold onto what happened. We're here to help them move forward.
lines.style: Gentle but clear. Speaking from conviction, not ceremony. Slight warmth on 'move forward.' The promise of support delivered quietly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、犯人が、絶対、奪う、絶対、人生、絶対、警察、絶対、お返しいたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect took something real. And now we're giving that person their life back.
lines.style: Quiet resonance. Each phrase lands with weight. Slow pace. Not celebratory—determined. The full meaning behind what justice means.
